title: Übermittlung an den KI-Dienst unter festen Auflagen
description: As a data protection officer, I want every transfer to the AI service to run only against a verified provider configuration, so that the data transfer is provably compliant.

acceptance_criteria.given: the provider configuration has been verified and a prompt is ready to be classified
acceptance_criteria.when: the scanner calls the AI service
acceptance_criteria.then: the provider receives the original prompt text without redaction
and: the transmission is recorded in the audit trail as metadata without content
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-022-external-provider-transfer.feature: The prompt content is transmitted unchanged

acceptance_criteria.given: the configured provider does not guarantee retention free processing in the EU
acceptance_criteria.when: the scanner would call the AI service
acceptance_criteria.then: the call is not executed and the version moves to FAILED
and: no prompt content leaves the system
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-022-external-provider-transfer.feature: A provider configuration that violates the terms aborts the scan

acceptance_criteria.given: the provider is reachable but the call fails with a timeout
acceptance_criteria.then: the version moves to FAILED and can be retried manually
and: no partial scan result is stored
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-022-external-provider-transfer.feature: A failing provider call leaves the version in a recoverable state
